titulo: Tecnología sin integración — estilo Memphis red + piso operativo (paleta azure #0285e2 + naranja #ff7006)
fuente: Referencia visual Midjourney del usuario + ajuste de paleta prioritaria
mundos: Referencia estilo flat Memphis (red digital + operaciones)
prompts:
Wide landscape flat vector illustration in clean corporate Memphis style, pale soft cream neutral background above a deep saturated azure-blue ground plane using tonal variations of bright sky-blue and vivid azure. Across the middle, a soft translucent glowing band carries a complex network of thin luminous connection lines and bright circular nodes in vivid warm tangerine-orange and amber-orange tonalities, representing live digital data flow. From several nodes, thin vertical orange light rays drop down connecting the network to ground operations. On the left, stacked cardboard boxes in soft orange and peach-orange tones beside a faceless logistics worker holding a tablet and a floating digital dashboard UI panel with abstract charts. Center, another faceless worker with headset interacting with a larger floating interface screen; nearby field workers carry boxes or check tablets. On the right, two rounded modern delivery vans painted in bright warm orange with darker orange shadows, parked on the azure-blue ground, a driver standing beside one van. Clothing mostly deep azure-blue and teal-blue with small orange accents. Overall palette prioritizes vivid azure blue and vivid warm orange in multiple soft and saturated shades, professional, modern, calm operational continuity, soft even lighting, no outlines, no photorealism --

ANTITEXT: keep all vehicle body panels, doors, and surfaces completely blank and clean with zero letters digits logos emblems barcodes QR codes labels stickers numbers or any readable marking of any kind; no typography anywhere in the scene; no brand names; no overlays; no headlines; no watermarks
nota: Paleta prioritaria descrita en palabras (sin hex en MJ). Azul ~#0285e2, naranja ~#ff7006, con variaciones tonales.
